newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran quake toll rises to 79 dead, 260 injured.
newsitem.headline: Iran quake toll rises to 79 dead, 260 injured.

text.p: The toll from two strong earthquakes that rocked a mountainous region in northeastern Iran this week rose to 79 dead and 260 injured, the Iranian news agency IRNA said on Thursday.

It quoted Deputy Interior Minister Rasoul Zargar as also saying some 25,000 people were made homeless by the quakes on Tuesday which were centred near the town of Bojnurd, about 580 km (360 miles) northeast of Tehran.
Zargar, who heads Iran's natural disasters agency, said some 65 villages were damaged by the tremors. Earlier reports had said 73 villages were levelled or heavily damaged.
More than 12,200 heads of cattle were killed by the quakes, Zargar added.
Tehran radio said there had been 290 aftershocks -- the strongest measuring 5.7 on the Richter scale -- since the two quakes which measured 6.1 and 5.4 on the Richter scale.
It said 2,000 rescue workers and emergency supplies had been sent to the stricken rural region and the government had earmarked five billion rials ($1.7 million) for reconstruction.
Tremors of force six can cause widespread damage and those of force five are powerful enough to cause heavy damage in a populated area.
Earthquakes hit Iran regularly. The worst recorded one, measuring 7.3 on the Richter scale, killed 35,000 people in a densely populated area near the Caspian coast in 1990.
($1=3,000 rials at the official exchange rate) FS cmd
